title: OTel, regression, Docker Compose, runbook
acceptance_criterion: A clean setup works; seeded regression fails CI; traces do not expose synthetic secrets
verdict: Observability + redaction + migrations + compose files + runbook are shipped and the redaction path is tested. But the MCP wiring this step owned was not delivered, the clean-setup claim is unverified, and the regression suite has a real (if env-only) failure. NOT complete.
evidence: src/agentops_workbench/observability/otel.py: spans + credential redaction; tests/test_observability.py = 15 tests pass
docker/docker-compose.yml + docker/Dockerfile present (postgres + api + worker + streamlit + mcp-document)
tests/test_auth_hardening.py = 10 tests is the seeded failure-to-regression suite for the import-PR review criticals
gaps: The work the step-5 stubs explicitly deferred to here ('step 6 wires real MCP calls') was never done — the topologies still have stubbed tool dispatch after step 6.

One test in the seeded regression suite currently FAILS in the dev environment (test_has_insecure_jwt_secret_flags_default_and_short) because it does not isolate the .env file. AC says 'seeded regression fails CI' as a positive property, but this failure is an accidental env leak, not the designed seeded failure.
'A clean setup works' (docker compose up) is not covered by any test or CI job; only the Python unit suite runs.
No end-to-end 'failed case -> regression test' artifact from step 5 (the step-5 comparison produced no functional failures to regress, because tools were stubbed).
